name: fan_self
text: A person stands in hot weather and fans their face with a handheld folding fan in their right hand. Right elbow is bent at the side, right wrist and forearm make repeated short brisk back-and-forth strokes beside the cheek to blow air toward the face. Left arm hangs relaxed. Repeat the fanning movement several times while standing.
